ui.trade_list_flavor:r_d1f4e55771cedc69.text:
Chimera secretly directed the wars of $$ＵＣＷ$$. The badges its members wore
were rumored to amplify human desire... or perhaps they did nothing of the sort.

ui.trade_list_flavor:r_90c2c24a288f8a49.text:
A rare treasure said to hold the fighting spirit of veterans of the $$破界事変$$.
Others call it a charm made to soothe the rage and grief of those the King of Destruction
turned into $$次元獣$$s.

ui.trade_list_flavor:r_5dad7bca57bb5de0.text: A rare treasure said to hold hopes for the world's rebirth at the end of the $$再世戦争$$. Others say it embodies the feelings of the prince who risked his life for his people, and those who supported him.

ui.trade_list_flavor:r_d0a9c7aca3a6c227.text:
One of the treasures passed down through the lost Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$.
Said to embody King $$インサラウム$$ I's love for his people,
it grants its bearer great power once.

ui.trade_list_flavor:r_70035399372f0447.text:
A product of the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$'s dimensional science.
It draws out $$次元力$$ using the user's will and life force as a key,
strengthening their machine's weapons.

ui.trade_list_flavor:r_562ea70fdf3034e5.text:
An integrated tactical-information AI using quantum computing.
Nearby allied machines can link to the equipped unit
to receive precise tactical guidance.

ui.trade_list_flavor:r_97be40178a940e39.text:
A universal repair and resupply system powered by dimensional energy.
It creates matter from nothing to replace damaged parts and replenish ammunition,
allowing it to service any type of machine.

ui.trade_list_flavor:r_0d8eacac10bb2f9f.text:
An autopilot specialized in defense. Its AI models the movements of an extremely timid
small animal from a certain star system. It selects the best defensive action
faster than human reflexes allow.

ui.trade_list_flavor:r_6099675c1f677f11.text:
A reward system that pays according to distance traveled.
It piggybacks on a pedometer promotion in a certain star system,
so its benefits will vanish when that campaign ends.

ui.trade_list_flavor:r_8f2cd355bf12984a.text: A retaliation system that returns your pain to the enemy. Widely used on mobile weapons in one star system, it was hard to handle. Many misjudged it and destroyed themselves, so it was discontinued.

ui.trade_list_flavor:r_76c6b1e74ca0d5d4.text: A system that forces spiral theory onto every weapon. Its effects are still being studied. Some researchers say its extra power is psychological, born of the pilot's love of a man's romantic ideals.

ui.trade_list_flavor:r_9662562cddc42c18.text:
A system that extracts $$次元力$$ from dimensional crystals.
It yields enormous energy, but the constant danger of a runaway reaction
places tremendous mental strain on the pilot.

ui.trade_list_flavor:r_ed3a28fadcfb56d9.text:
A system that generates dimensional quakes in a tiny area.
It distorts nearby space for a variety of defensive uses,
though some users experience symptoms similar to motion sickness.

ui.trade_list_flavor:r_91373d84ff63f567.text:
A movement aid that enters and exits subspace. This pseudo-teleportation needs less
energy than travel between parallel worlds. It also offers the thrill of wondering
whether you might never come back.

ui.trade_list_flavor:r_33d35697d094e033.text:
A system that amplifies the elation of defeating an enemy.
It stimulates the release of pleasure chemicals in the brain, making the user feel wonderful.
Using it therefore requires strong self-discipline.

ui.trade_list_flavor:r_dd32b70c24f08444.text: A system that strengthens bonds between partners. Made to help couples in a rut, it drew attention for its potential to work on any relationship between two people, and was put into practical use.

ui.trade_list_flavor:r_41eafee448f53c38.text:
A talisman made from crystallized wishes and prayers.
Its effects are real, not merely comforting: it grants its user great power.
Indeed, people have even fought over it.

ui.trade_list_flavor:r_4349e285349e8fed.text:
A system that draws $$次元力$$ from human life force itself.
It requires Focus to be raised to the limit,
so its user must possess considerable strength.
